title: 04. Cuts & Connections (24k–21k)
description: Keep your own stones connected into one strong group while slicing through the opponent's weak points.

puzzles.title: Protect the Cutting Point
puzzles.prompt: Black has a diagonal shape at D5 and E4. White is threatening to wedge between them. Connect solidly!

solutions.feedback: Solid connection! Playing E5 turns two separate diagonal stones into a single unified 3-stone group with 6 liberties.

wrongHints.default: If White plays E5, your D5 and E4 stones get split apart. Occupy E5 yourself to link them into one unbreakable group.

puzzles.title: Cut the Diagonal
puzzles.prompt: White left two diagonal stones at E5 and F6 unprotected. Slice between them to split White into two weak groups!

solutions.feedback: Sharp cut! F5 links with your E6 stone and splits White's E5 and F6 stones apart, leaving E5 in Atari!

wrongHints.default: Look at the empty intersection F5—it touches both of White's diagonal stones while connecting to your stone at E6.

puzzles.title: Form the Tiger's Mouth
puzzles.concept: A Tiger's Mouth is a 3-stone jaw whose open mouth cannot be entered by the opponent without putting themselves in instant Atari.
puzzles.prompt: You hold D5 and E6 while White presses at E4. Complete a Tiger's Mouth so White cannot wedge between your stones!

solutions.feedback: Textbook Tiger's Mouth! D5-D6-E6 forms a jaw around E5—if White ever plays E5, you capture it immediately!

wrongHints.E5: E5 creates a heavy Empty Triangle with fewer liberties—play D6 instead to form an efficient Tiger's Mouth!
wrongHints.default: Play D6 to create a 3-stone Tiger's Mouth guarding E5 with maximum liberties.

puzzles.title: Unbreakable Bamboo Joint
puzzles.concept: Two parallel 2-stone pillars separated by 1 space form a Bamboo Joint—neither middle point can be cut because the other immediately connects.
puzzles.prompt: You hold D6-D5 on the left and F6-F5 on the right. White peeps at E6 trying to cut. Complete the Bamboo Joint!

solutions.feedback: Rock solid! E5 links all five stones into a single 8-liberty fortress and leaves White's E6 peep isolated.

wrongHints.default: Connect across the bottom of the two pillars at E5 so White's E6 stone cannot slice through.

puzzles.title: Hanging Connection
puzzles.concept: When a diagonal pair is threatened from one side, stepping into the adjacent knight's-move anchor links both stones while expanding outward.
puzzles.prompt: Your stones at D6 and E5 are threatened by White at D5. Connect cleanly toward the center!

solutions.feedback: Solid! E6 connects D6 and E5 into a unified chain and threatens to counter-attack White's D5 stone.

wrongHints.default: White is threatening to push into E6 and split D6 from E5—occupy E6 first to stay connected!

puzzles.title: Wedge Through a Loose Jump
puzzles.concept: A one-space jump with enemy stones pressing directly behind it can be wedged right through the middle.
puzzles.prompt: White has a loose one-space jump at C5 and E5 while you hold C4-D4. Slice right through the middle!

solutions.feedback: Sharp wedge! D5 splits C5 and E5 right down the middle while standing solidly on your C4-D4 base.

wrongHints.default: Drive straight into the open space at D5 between C5 and E5!
